name: Pearl Harbor
hook: December 7, 1941: the Arizona, the infamy speech and the attack that brought America into the war.

facts.label: December 7, 1941
facts.statement: Japan attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941, drawing the United States into World War II.

facts.label: the USS Arizona
facts.statement: The USS Arizona was sunk in the attack; its wreck still leaks oil beneath the memorial in Pearl Harbor.

facts.label: Oahu
facts.statement: Pearl Harbor is on Oahu, the most populous Hawaiian island and home of the U.S. Pacific Fleet headquarters.

facts.label: Isoroku Yamamoto
facts.statement: Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto planned the attack and had attended Harvard in 1919; he was shot down in 1943.

facts.label: day of infamy speech
facts.statement: Franklin D. Roosevelt's December 1941 'day of infamy' speech was typed in first draft by Grace Tully.

facts.label: Pearl Harbor on film
facts.statement: From Here to Eternity and Tora! Tora! Tora! are the classic films about the attack.

facts.label: Guam and the Philippines
facts.statement: Days after Pearl Harbor, Japan occupied Guam, and on the same day it bombed Clark and Iba airfields in the Philippines.
